## Change

<!-- What problem does this solve, and what changes for the user?
Keep this PR focused on one underlying problem; explain why changes across
components belong to the same fix. Submit unrelated fixes or cleanup separately.
Link the issue for a bug fix, or the discussion if there is one. For a very small,
obvious bug fix without an issue, explain why it qualifies for the exception
in CONTRIBUTING.md. -->

## Verification

<!-- What did you test, and what was the result? For a bug, include the failing
case and the result after the fix. Say what you could not verify. -->

## Client UI evidence (when applicable)

<!-- For changes to appearance or interaction, attach before/after screenshots
from the packaged app showing the same scenario. Add a short recording for
motion, timing, transitions, or interaction details. Follow CONTRIBUTING.md's
Client UI evidence requirements. Upload or link media; do not commit PR-only
assets. Delete this section when the change does not affect the UI. -->

## Use and need (new packages, applications, extensions, or drivers)

<!-- Delete this section for other changes. For a new addition, explain who needs
it and why existing options are not enough. Describe your own use inside Octopus:
what you installed, a real task it completed, your setup, and what remains untested.
Include a short, redacted result; for visual extensions, complete Client UI evidence.
A build, mocked test, or tool listing alone does not establish practical use. -->

## Architecture fit (only when applicable)

<!-- Delete this section for changes that preserve the existing architecture.
If this changes architectural responsibilities, contracts, or mechanisms:

Could existing descriptors, interfaces, or client behavior solve it more simply?
Explain why the proposed approach is needed. -->
